name: Sea Turtles Program
summary: Grants for sea turtle recovery work, mainly nesting beach habitat restoration and protection in Florida, the US Virgin Islands and Puerto Rico, bycatch reduction, stranding response and rehabilitation capacity, and population-scale networks. The 1:1 match applies to beach and bycatch work only.

geography.label: Mostly U.S. beaches and coastal waters; other Western Hemisphere projects a lower priority

deadline.text: Pre-Proposal Due Date August 19, 2026, 11:59 pm EST

status.quote: Sea Turtles 2027 Request For Proposals - CLOSED

deadline.quote: Pre-Proposal Due Date August 19, 2026, 11:59 pm EST Invitations for Full Proposals Sent September 2026

applicant_types.quote: Eligible applicants include: Non-profit 501(c) organizations State government agencies Local governments Municipal governments Tribal Governments and Organizations Educational institutions International organizations For-profit organizations

geography.quote: Most funded projects will take place along U.S. state or territorial beaches, facilities, or coastal waters. Other projects targeting sea turtle conservation in the Western Hemisphere will be considered but as a lower priority for funding.

access.quote: All application materials must be submitted online through National Fish and Wildlife Foundation's Easygrants system.

window.quote: Full Proposal Due Date October 27, 2026, 11:59 pm EST

amount.quote: Most awards under this program will fall in the range of $50,000 to $400,000

co_finance_required.quote: is required for beach and bycatch work and is accepted for stranding/rehabilitation projects but not required
